idea-plugin.name: Claude Usage Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps an eye on your Claude usage from the IDE status bar (bottom-right). The widget shows 14% used | resets in 1:14 — how much of your subscription quota is gone and when it resets.

Two things, one widget:

  • Subscription quota — the 5-hour, 7-day and 7-day-Sonnet limits, each with a percentage, a colour indicator (green → yellow → red) and the time to the next reset. Same numbers as claude → /usage.
  • Tokens used — total tokens sent and received (and prompt-cache traffic, shown separately) for today, the last week and the last month, counted locally from the Claude Code transcript logs.

Click the widget for the breakdown. Configure it under Settings → Tools → Claude Usage Monitor (which quota to show, refresh interval, colour thresholds, threshold notifications).

No login. The plugin reuses the OAuth token the Claude Code CLI already stored (~/.claude/.credentials.json, or the macOS Keychain). It only ever sends that token to api.anthropic.com over HTTPS to read your usage — nowhere else. It never writes your credentials, and there is no telemetry.

Requirements: the Claude Code CLI installed and signed in.

Free and open source (MIT, on GitHub). Not affiliated with Anthropic. The subscription-quota endpoint it reads is undocumented and may change without notice; the token view keeps working regardless.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — Initial release.
  • Status-bar widget: % used | resets in H:MM for the selected quota, with a colour indicator.
  • Click-through popup: 5-hour / 7-day / 7-day-Sonnet quota, plus tokens used today / last week / last month.
  • Settings: quota tier, refresh interval, colour thresholds, threshold notifications, credentials path.
  • macOS Keychain support with credentials-file fallback.
